name: Baseball
description:
Step up to the plate in Baseball, a simple yet thrilling game where you control all the action on the field. Choose between easy, medium, or hard difficulty to match your skill level and start swinging! As the hitter, perfect your timing to send the ball flying. 

Then, switch roles to the pitcher, where you’ll need precision and skill to fill the power meter and deliver the ultimate throw. If the opposing team connects, react quickly to pass the ball between bases and tag out their runners. Accessible and fun for all, Baseball brings endless excitement to every match!
